english.title: Intentionally participate in activities to circumvent prohibitions or enable / facilitate their contravention - Ukraine
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally participated in activities, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITIES..), knowing that the object or effect of them would directly or indirectly, circumvent or enable or facilitate the contravention of the prohibition in regulation **(..SPECIFY REGULATION NUMBER..) of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(2) and 12(1) of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence may be committed by conduct wholly or partly outside the United Kingdom when it is conduct of a UK national or a body incorporated or constituted under the law of the United Kingdom.
(ii) For details regarding jurisdictional issues and bringing of proceedings, please see regulation 13.
(iii) Proceedings may not be instituted under the regulations in England or Wales unless there is consent from the Attorney General. See regulation 14 for further detail regarding consent. Consent is not needed for summary offences.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and/or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
